context:
Goal: fix slow merges, and merge only the head CI ran on.
Problem (rule): #2274 rewrites the settings.json auto-mode entry "Batch Runner Merge", and a settings change needs your word.
Based on (read): the entry then allows only `merge <pr> --confirm --head <sha>`, with the head named in the merge go, and lists "a merge with no --head" as never covered. It narrows the entry and widens nothing.
Based on (read): #2249 (a relayed merge yes binds to the PR head) is merged; #2274's round 3 passed with net value positive.
Departs from: main's "Batch Runner Merge" entry, which allows `merge <pr> --confirm` with no head — #2274 requires `--head <sha>`.
Meanwhile: #2274 is parked; batch 69 goes on without it.

options.gain: The batch runner can merge only the commit CI ran on.
options.label: Yes, allow the settings change as written
options.lose: A merge go that forgets the head is refused, and the coordinator resends it with the head.

options.label: No, keep main's entry
options.lose: The merge tool refuses a merge with no head, but the permission entry still describes the old form, so the two disagree.

reply: Routed 13:11 CST Nov 9 to step runner-merge-needs-head (lane session_013NEJKzw6Mmu5eviHC3vobt, via the coordinator), roadmap 2e2d190de. The settings change in #2274 is allowed as written.
short: Batch runner merges only the CI-run head
title: Let #2274 narrow the batch runner's merge permission so it merges only the commit CI ran on? This needs your word for a settings.json change.
